name: openweathermap
title: OpenWeather
summary: Current weather, 5 day forecast, One Call 3.0, air pollution and geocoding with the appid query key, and city-not-found, invalid-key, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: OpenWeather publishes no OpenAPI or other machine-readable description; the contract is hand-written from the public documentation. Community specs on GitHub carry no licence, so none is pinned.
